title: Mempheez
description:
Expanding regions strive to maximize their reach, stretching out like vibrant brushstrokes on a canvas. Colliding blobs engage in a dynamic dance, jostling for dominance until a delicate equilibrium is disrupted, and a state of entropy is reluctantly embraced.

This chaotic spectacle draws inspiration from the eclectic realms of Memphis design, the intricate tapestry of world maps, the cozy complexity of quilts, and the whimsical chaos of the multiverse seen in Rick and Morty. Each element contributes its own unique flavor, blending together in a harmonious clash of patterns and narratives.

title: High Spirits!
description:
There’s always a time and a place to let loose, sit back, and lift those spirits! Through the ages, images of the filled cup, mug, or cocktail glass have molded the way we envision relaxation and good times. They’ve encoded an escape, a panacea, a nostalgic refuge, and a feeling that we seek — but may not find. 

So instead, let’s stay in the moment and live sip by sip, here and now. Let’s look directly into the blazing neon lights, experience something unexpected, and remember that the best drink is one shared. Cheers to all!

--------

Many pieces of High Spirits! match the community-favorite cocktails shared in the Tender Discord’s #happyhour channel… others are timeless cocktails and mocktails, defined in bold headline. Still more outputs are generative mysteries, concocted from Mr. Kislev’s Kode, open to your inventive interpretations. Enjoy the eighties electric vibes and mid-century styling, print a poster, and trade for your favorites!

--------

TENDER x Orr Kislev
September 2022

title: MONOLITH
description:
Very limited facts are known about these strange monolithic structures. Black, rectilinear, similar to obsidian stone but made of strange materials. According to legend, an ancient civilization of high intelligence, called the Explorers of Latent Space, distributed hundreds of monoliths throughout time and space in order to study the behavior of species in the infinite Universe.

Some say that it is the divine intelligence of God. Others say that, in spite of their objectual and material condition, the monoliths possess their own consciousness and an intelligence beyond the natural and artificial. Their purpose or objective, to this day, remains a mystery.

title: Pobbles
description:
The pobbles are generative blob-rocks: staring in silence, sometimes half-smiling, generally bored. 

• The pobbles are digital recreations of a series of rock-doodles by S.F.Kislev (my big brother). They are an attempt to capture a specific, singular handwriting, and evolve it using code. 
• See the original, 2014 handmade version here - https://pobbles.tez.page..
• Alternative titles considered include Peggles™, Plops™, Blobbies™, Floofs™, Flintstones™, Lardies™, Plumps™, Fats™ and Wet-Ones™. 
• The pobbles are written entirely in paper.js and p5.js. 
• The pobbles are an effort to take generative art into the realm of the cute. 
• They work well with toddlers.

🖨️ Collectors minting at the first auction tier receive a hand-crafted riso print of their pobble. Color variation between the file and the print will apply. 🖨️
